name: Grok Bot
summary: Talk to your Grok Bot AI teammates by voice.
description: See your Grok Bot teammates, message one, catch up on what a bot said, create a new bot, or start a group chat with several at once — all by voice, from the notch.

preferences.name: SHOW_BOT_NOTIFICATIONS
preferences.title: Show notifications from bots
preferences.description: Show a notch pill when a bot replies or a scheduled task finishes.

blocks.text: 1. Install Grok Bot and sign in
Install the Grok Bot app on this Mac, open it, and sign in. VoiceOS uses that session, so there are no keys to paste.

The first time you use Grok Bot in VoiceOS, macOS asks for access to "Grok Bot Safe Storage" in your Keychain. It shows on your screen, not in VoiceOS. Type your Mac password and click Always Allow, so it does not ask again.

blocks.alt: The macOS Keychain popup asking for access to Grok Bot Safe Storage, with an Always Allow button
blocks.caption: Click Always Allow.

blocks.text: Say "Create a bot named Scout that checks my inbox."
Turn on "Show notifications from bots" below to get a ping when a bot replies. To mute one bot, say "Turn off Piper's notifications".

tools.name: view_bot_desktop_live
tools.title: View a bot's live screen
tools.description: Watch a bot's computer screen live while it works.

bot.description: The bot's name as the user said it, e.g. 'Piper'.

tools.name: grokbot_show
tools.title: Show bots
tools.description: See all your bots, or what one bot is doing right now.

bot.description: A bot's name as the user said it, e.g. 'Piper'. Omit to list every bot.

tools.name: grokbot_list
tools.title: List bots
tools.description: List every Grok Bot teammate and group chat on one card. Use when the user asks to see their bots or what bots they have.

tools.name: grokbot_help
tools.title: How to use Grok Bot
tools.description: Show how to set up and use Grok Bot: a card with the setup steps (checked on this Mac), then things the user can say. Use when the user asks how to use or set up Grok Bot, what Grok Bot can do, or for help with this integration.

page.description: 'ideas' when the user asks only what they can do or say with Grok Bot; omit to start on setup.

tools.name: grokbot_thread
tools.title: Read a bot's messages
tools.description: Read what one Grok Bot teammate said, found, or did. Use for ANY question about a bot's messages or results: what it said, summarize its work, answer a question from it, or draft something from it. Returns the message text in `thread`; read it and do what the user asked in your own words. Set show only when the user asks to see or open the conversation. Accounts a bot needs (Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, …) cannot be connected by voice or in VoiceOS: tell the user to press "Open in Grok Bot" on that request in the bot's card, or open the bot's chat in the Grok Bot app, and connect it there.

bot.description: The bot's name as the user said it.

limit.description: How many recent messages; omit for a short default.

show.description: True only when the user asks to see or open the conversation. Omit to just read it.

tools.name: grokbot_prepare_message
tools.title: Check message recipients
tools.description: Check the live Grok Bot roster before a group message, or when the user names no bot. Use FIRST for group messages. For ONE named bot, skip this and call grokbot_send directly: its hook verifies the name. When the user names no bot ('send this task to Grok Bot': Grok Bot is the app, not a bot), call this with no arguments to get every bot's role. Never pass the message here: write it once, in the next tool call. Pass names as the user said them. This read-only lookup does not send. On success call nextTool with the returned args plus the message. On failure stop and explain the recipient could not be found; do not guess another bot, create a bot, or retry automatically.

bot.description: One bot's name as the user said it, or a known ID. Omit for groups.

group.description: An existing group's name as the user said it, or its ID.

members.description: Group members as the user said them, or their IDs.

groupName.description: A new group name, composed as the user would type it.

tools.name: grokbot_send
tools.title: Message a bot
tools.description: Ask or tell one of your bots something. Its chat opens so you can keep talking.

confirmationContext.description: Internal: copy confirmationContext unchanged from the successful grokbot_prepare_message result, if present. Never compose it yourself.

bot.description: One Grok Bot's name as the user said it, or its exact ID from grokbot_prepare_message. When the user named no bot, the one bot whose role fits the task (from the turn's Grok Bot roster), never a default. The SDK hook verifies the recipient. Unknown or group names are rejected: never substitute another bot.

message.description: The message or task, written TO the bot the way the user would type it: meaning kept, lead-in verbs like 'tell Piper to' dropped, reported speech made direct ('ask Piper how the test is going' → 'How's the test going?'). Send a long task whole, with its line breaks.

recipientId.description: Internal: recipient ID pinned by the preparation hook. Never compose or change this value.

tools.name: grokbot_card_send
tools.title: Send from the bot card
tools.description: Internal — called only by the Grok Bot card's message box, never by voice. Do not call this tool; for a spoken request use grokbot_send or grokbot_group.

bot.description: 1:1 — the exact bot (or group) ID or name shown on the card.

group.description: Group thread — the existing group's ID. Omit with members for a new group.

members.description: Group thread — member bot IDs (edited on the card).

message.description: The text the user typed in the card.

tools.name: grokbot_create
tools.title: Create a bot
tools.description: Make a new bot. Say its name and what it should do.

name.description: A short name for the new bot, as the user said it.

description.description: The bot's job / instructions, composed the way the user would write them from what they asked for.

label.description: A one- or two-word tag for the bot (e.g. 'School', 'Research'), as the user said it.

notifications.description: Whether the bot should send notifications. Omit unless the user said.

color.description: Avatar color, one of Grok Bot's palette names. Comes from the card; omit unless the user named a color.

shape.description: Avatar shape, one of Grok Bot's picker shapes. Comes from the card; omit unless the user named a shape.

tools.name: grokbot_notifications
tools.title: Bot notifications
tools.description: Turn one Grok Bot's notifications on or off (the bot's "Notify on updates" switch in the Grok Bot app). Off means no notch ping when that bot replies or finishes a scheduled task. Use when the user asks to mute, silence, unmute, or turn on/off notifications for a bot. Not for all bots at once: that is the "Show notifications from bots" setting in Grok Bot's VoiceOS settings.

bot.description: The bot's name as the user said it.

enabled.description: true to turn the bot's notifications on, false to turn them off.

children.text: Pings in the notch when this bot replies or finishes a scheduled task.

tools.name: grokbot_group
tools.title: Message a group chat
tools.description: Send the user's message to a Grok Bot group chat right away (an existing group, or a new one created from two or more named bots), then open that group's live chat. Use when the user asks to message several bots or a group. Spoken member or name changes are saved before it sends. Without a message, or with fewer than two bots for a new group, it only opens the group pane. Use AFTER grokbot_prepare_message succeeds for this request, copying its returned args including resolved group/member IDs, and adding the message. Never call after a missing or ambiguous recipient lookup.

confirmationContext.description: Internal: copy confirmationContext unchanged from the successful grokbot_prepare_message result, if present. Never compose it yourself.

group.description: An existing group's name as the user said it, or its exact id from a card. Omit for a new group.

members.description: Bots to include, as names the user said or exact ids. Omit to use an existing group's members, or to choose members in the card.

groupName.description: The new or edited group name, composed as the user would type it. Omit to preserve an existing name; leave empty to name a new group in the card.

message.description: The message to send, written TO the group the way the user would type it: lead-in commands removed, reported speech made direct.

tools.name: grokbot_card_snapshot
tools.title: Refresh conversation
tools.description: Internal read-only tool for the visible Grok Bot conversation card. Use grokbot_thread for spoken requests.

tools.name: grokbot_card_image
tools.title: Load conversation image
tools.description: Internal read-only image loader for Grok Bot cards. Resolves only an image belonging to the specified transcript entry.

tools.name: grokbot_card_action
tools.title: Respond to a conversation card
tools.description: Internal — only invoke from a user's click on a Grok Bot card. Never select or dismiss an answer on the user's behalf. Handles the exact selected options or opens Grok Bot's native authentication and approval flow.

tools.name: grokbot_card_entry
tools.title: Load complete conversation message
tools.description: Internal read-only loader for complete Grok Bot messages. The card automatically reads bounded chunks; no user action or native-app handoff is needed.

tools.name: grokbot_open_computer_window
tools.title: Open a bot's computer window
tools.description: Internal — invoked by the live screen card when the user taps it, to open that bot's computer in a larger window. Do not call from voice.

bot.description: The bot's name or identifier as the user said it, e.g. 'Piper'.

tools.name: grokbot_card_screen
tools.title: Open a bot's screen in the card
tools.description: Internal — invoked by the show card's screen pane to load a bot's live desktop inside the card. Do not call from voice.

bot.description: The exact bot ID shown on the card.

tools.name: grokbot_reply_check
tools.title: Check a bot's latest reply
tools.description: Internal — polled by the screen card's message bar after the user sends a message, to show the bot's reply on the card. Do not call from voice.

bot.description: The exact bot ID shown on the card.

since.description: Epoch milliseconds: only replies at or after this time count.

intents.name: list_bots
intents.description: List the user's Grok Bot teammates and group chats. Only list bots, without sending a message or opening a bot's computer. Never when the user gives a task or message to send, even one that names no bot ('send this task to Grok Bot').

intents.name: show_bot
intents.description: Open one known Grok Bot's conversation and current progress. Do not send a message or show its computer screen. Never when the user gives a task or message to send.

intents.name: send_message
intents.description: Send a message or task to one Grok Bot right away and open its live chat. Each bot choice is its name, then its role. A name the user says wins, even if another bot's role fits better. If the user names no bot, or the name is unclear or misheard, pick the one bot whose role clearly fits the task (school work → the school bot); 'Grok Bot', 'a bot' or 'my bot' is the app, not a name. If two bots fit equally or none fits, do not pick. 'Send this task to …' and 'dispatch …' are sends. Write the message TO the bot, the way the user would type it: it is sent exactly as written. Make reported speech direct ('ask <bot> how the test is going' → 'How's the test going?'). Drop the lead-in, keep the meaning and line breaks, capital first letter, right end punctuation. A long task is one whole message. Reject groups, multiple recipients, or separate actions outside the message.

examples: Can you check the latest build?

intents.name: view_screen
intents.description: Show the live screen of ONE named bot in the notch: see its screen, watch it, or what it is working on. Not a bigger or separate window, not its messages.

intents.name: open_chat
intents.description: Open or show the conversation with ONE named bot. Only for seeing or opening the chat. Not for questions about what the bot said, summaries, or sending a message.

intents.name: create_bot
intents.description: Create a new Grok bot when the user gives BOTH a name and what the bot should do. Not when either is missing.

en: Make a new bot called {name} to {description}

intents.name: mute_bot
intents.description: Turn OFF notifications for ONE named bot. Not for all bots, and not to turn them on.

intents.name: unmute_bot
intents.description: Turn ON notifications for ONE named bot. Not for all bots, and not to turn them off.

intents.name: help
intents.description: Show how to set up and use Grok Bot, and what the user can say to it. Only a guide; do not list, message or create bots.
